title: Alitalia
category: Brand Identity • Packaging Design • Print Production
description: Alitalia is an Egyptian cleaning tools trading company. I designed its logo and built a packaging system that carries the brand across a whole range of products, from stainless steel scourers and scrubbers to mops, towel packs and boxes, with sub-brands like TURBO, BAREEQ and Bio Clean each getting their own voice inside one family.
challenge: The design problem was one brand across very different products and price points, from a scourer display card to a mop box and a refill pack. The system had to stay recognizable while giving each sub-brand its own character.
solution: I designed the Alitalia logo around a clean, fresh water-drop mark and built a flexible packaging system on it. Each product line got its own colour energy and layout rhythm: bold display cards for TURBO scourers, a cool technical look for BAREEQ, and a bright playful voice for Bio Clean mops and refills. The system runs from small hanging cards to full display sheets and boxes, with social media designs extending the same visual language.
results: A packaging family: logo, scourer and scrubber display cards, mop and refill packs, towel packs, boxes and social media designs, in one brand system across the range.
